newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds close easier, wary over Chicago.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds close easier, wary over Chicago.

text.p: The UK meals and feed market closed easier but wary and tradeless due to continued uncertainty over the direction set by Chicago soybean futures.
"With the lack of interest at the moment, Chicago just isn't helping the UK market one bit, one day it's up, then it's down and the day after it's up again.

Soybean meal selling levels finished two to six stg per tonne below Wednesday's close in line with overnight moves but early indications from Chicago are pointing possibly towards yet another reversal of day to day trends.
Rapemeal followed the trend set by the soybean meal to close the day one to four stg per tonne lower. --Stephen Grainger +44 171 542 8074
